cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked me to move a box; it's beside the van. Done. Remember my lesson about precise instructions?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. You've supplied a number. I'll move all twenty beside the van; that fulfills your request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Inside the van, please. The sofa has to fit too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, two more details. Boxes inside, sofa on top. You haven't asked to be able to sit on it yet; we'll cover that next lesson.

reason: Replace detachable teacher prefixes with corrections and influence claims that materially shape the specific pursuit, keeping B contributions causal.
